excerpt: You do not need a perfect morning or a huge plan. You need twenty honest minutes pointed at something that matters.
body1: Big goals are exciting, but they can become so large that starting feels impossible. Choose one useful action that fits inside twenty minutes. Open the document. Walk around the block. Read three pages. Make the first version deliberately small.
header2: Make the promise easy to keep
body2: The point is not to prove that you can work forever. The point is to become someone who returns. A small promise kept today is more valuable than a dramatic plan postponed until next month.
header3: Let momentum do its quiet work
body3: After twenty minutes, you can stop without guilt or continue because the hardest part is already behind you. Either way, you have given your attention a direction. That is how a life changes: not all at once, but repeatedly.
